classification: Frozen fictional profiles with a separate profile-inferred comparison round. First offers preserve original answers; current offers include the comparison answers and a separate frozen core-work confirmation round. These are simulations, not recorded student behavior.

methods: Preserve every original profile and work answer. Freeze the initially offered up to three profession comparisons per model before new answer authoring.

Additional answers are inferred by separate authors given only biographies and question/option text, with evidence and uncertainty; answers are frozen before final matching. Existing answers are reused, not replaced.

Run planMatchCandidates across explored fields and focused checks. Top requires two defining-work interests plus existing profile, task and clinical gates. Profile-inferred medium/low confidence remains provisional. Independent supporting question groups measure evidence breadth; short checks do not gain a percentage advantage.

Education preferences and realistic first-paid-stage pay order comparably supported matches. Comparisons awaiting review are invitations. Pending core interests appear under Needs confirmation. Starting-pay coverage remains a separate financial assessment.
Lifestyle options use the same five education groups and five-per-group cap, deduplicated across groups.
A lifestyle option must cover its monthly budget at the first paid stage, meet the displayed gross-income threshold, and not require prior role experience.
Stored career previews are comparisons, not recorded career choices.
